description: Read-only. Checks any deep link, from any vendor (a Firebase Dynamic Link on page.link, Branch app.link, a Strait link, a plain URL): where it goes on Android, iPhone and computers, whether it still works, and what to fix. Use it before migrating links or when an old link stopped working. Only public https links. No key needed; a few checks a minute per network.
name: check_link
title: Check any deep link
